1. Apparatus Detail on 1 Corinthians 12:10 (P01F-E005)
Previous Statement: In Turn 4, P01F-E005 stated that the editor rejects the conjunction δὲ across several clauses, "adopting an asyndetic reading not found in any of the four primary reference editions."
Correction / Clarification: Across the five variation units in 1 Corinthians 12:10, Holmes adopts a reading not found in any of the four primary editions (WH Treg NIV RP) at the first occurrence (10 ⸀ἄλλῳ Holmes ] + δὲ WH Treg NIV RP) and the fifth occurrence (⸀2ἄλλῳ Holmes ] + δὲ WH Treg NIV RP)
